children: Xenia posted an investor presentation outlining its 29 luxury and upper-upscale hotel portfolio, balance sheet strength and FY2026 guidance implications.
Furnished Investor Presentation (Exhibit 99.1) posted on Xenia's IR website for investor meetings; may be removed at company's discretion.
Portfolio: 29 branded luxury/upper-upscale hotels across 22 markets, 8,783 rooms, concentrated in Top-25 and leisure markets.
Balance sheet: ~$1.37B total debt, ~$612M liquidity ($112M cash + $500M undrawn LOC); ~76% fixed or hedged; 93% unencumbered portfolio.
FY2026 guidance (as of July 30, 2026): Adjusted EBITDAre $187–199M, Adjusted FFO $178–194M, Adj. FFO/sh $1.86–2.08; capex $70–80M; weighted avg diluted shares/units 95.7M.

Operational momentum: Same-property RevPAR up in July/August 2026; Grand Hyatt Scottsdale renovation driving strong group and pool revenues with expected high-single-digit to low $30M hotel EBITDA in 2026.
